A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AMPK activation ameliorates the eicosanoid imbalance in the kidney with HFD.
AMPK activation ameliorates HFD-induced renal lipotoxicity, in part by modulating the pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory eicosaoid pathways.
AMPK activation ameliorates HFD-induced kidney injury by correcting the eicosanoid pathway dysregulation in kidneys and in the renal circulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AMPK activation ameliorates HFD-induced eicosanoid changes in kidneys and the renal circulation.
AMPK activation can correct the HFD-induced pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory eicosaoid dysregulation.
AMPK is a key regulator of the eicosanoid pathway in the kidney and its activation may provide a novel therapeutic target for HFD-induced kidney diseases.
